specificity_estimand.learned_statistic: T(Q_learned) = median_i r_i(Q_learned) over the 16 fixed fresh coefficient identities
specificity_estimand.random_population: Prospectively sampled rank-8 orientations conditional on a fully specified, outcome-free safety qualification rule for all 47 fixed coefficient identities

candidate_family_ruling.AMBIENT_HAAR_RANK8: Conceptually clear ambient-orientation null, but full-bank safety-conditioned sampling feasibility is not established.
candidate_family_ruling.LEARNED_ORTHOGONAL_COMPLEMENT_HAAR_RANK8: Useful secondary contrast against overlap with the learned span, but not representative of the ambient random-orientation population.
candidate_family_ruling.ACTIVATION_COVARIANCE_MATCHED_RANK8: Potentially strongest anisotropy-matched control, but no complete pre-outcome ambient covariance construction and regularization rule is presently frozen.

route_ruling.ROUTE_1: Cheaper but vulnerable to campaign/time/seed comparability and does not provide a fully paired learned-versus-random contrast.
route_ruling.ROUTE_2: Scientifically preferred if feasibility is solved; reruns learned and random subspaces on common items and seeds, with subspace-level inference.
route_ruling.ROUTE_3: A nonselective feasibility pilot can diagnose safety and runtime, but cannot select subspaces using semantic outcomes and consumes scarce compute without increasing confirmatory N.

key_power.configuration: ROUTE_2, S=20, N=300, R=2, K_ref=31, K_fresh=16, generic mean=0.35, subspace SD=0.10

key_compute.configuration: ROUTE_2, S=20, N=300, R=2, full 47 identities

blocking_design_issues: The target distribution over safety-conditioned random orientations is not yet operationally defined and qualified for the requirement that all 47 fixed coefficient identities pass both shells.

At empirical per-controller qualification rates, an independence sensitivity calculation makes complete 47-of-47 qualification extremely rare; dependence within an orientation is unknown and cannot be assumed favorable.

The most defensible paired full-panel route requires approximately 1.184 million semantic trajectories for only S=20 and has weak-to-moderate power for modest or 25%-of-observed specificity advantages.
The covariance-matched random family lacks a frozen ambient covariance operator, whitening/regularization rule, and resulting orientation law.
required_resolution_before_prelock: Freeze a scientifically interpretable safety-conditioned orientation population without changing the 47 coefficient identities or shell targets.
Run a model-free or label-free feasibility study that estimates complete-bank qualification at the orientation level without semantic outcome screening.
Specify the ambient covariance-matched construction or explicitly reject it before selecting the primary random family.
Adopt an explicit compute ceiling and minimum practically important specificity advantage before choosing S and N.
